chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man narrated from Abdullah ibn Numayr, from al-A'mash, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd.
That Ali عليه السلام gave the grandmother the entire estate.

key_terms.الْجَدَّةَ: the grandmother, as an inheriting relative in this ruling
key_terms.الْمَالَ: the property or estate being distributed
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it; the entirety of the estate

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the grandmother’s share in inheritance?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام regarding inheritance, stating that the grandmother was given the entire estate. It is a concise legal narration relevant to the laws of inheritance among ascending relatives.
